subject: Boolean literals
notes: Format 1 B"[0|1]..."/B'...' and Format 2 BX"[hex]..."/BX'...' with the character sequence OPTIONAL under both delimiters. BOOL_BODY = 'B' STR_BODY | 'BX' STR_BODY: one body for both delimiters and both formats, zero length legal, the [01] and hexadecimal-digit repertoires asked of the whole token by LiteralScreen (COBOL2630, kb/Work PB1441); caseInsensitive lexer. Probes out/probe/boolean-literals/bl1 (B"0101", B'10', BX"...", BX'f0', VALUE BX'0f') and bl12 (B"", B'', BX'', BX"") all accepted with correct values. cite.py --check 8.3.3.4.2 "hexadecimal-boolean" OK. No spec-derived test exercises the apostrophe spelling of either format (r03 covers BX"..." only) -> test-ref empty.
